title: Goal Achieved: A Toast for the Unknown

text_block_list.text:
…On a certain day, as the flowers prepare 
to bloom for Spring.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff ——

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today…! Your 
goals should all be complete with this…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fuu… I think I've finally managed to take a small step forward.

Stay Gold has finally obtained the track 
record allowing her to compete in the 
Classics, and discovered what it means to 
have "Fast and Tenacious Legs".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
……I am quite surprised that you were able 
make it this far before Spring.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah. I needed you to treat to me like the way you did, otherwise I wouldn't have been fit for the upcoming battle, neither for the Classics, nor for my future.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thanks McQueen.
It's only because you were 
here,
that I was able to trudge onward and 
discover a new path.
choice_data_list: From my heart also, thank you very...
From my heart also, thank you very...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
…I only followed the training plan set by 
Trainer, and poured my heart into running 
with you.
choice_data_list: From me as well, once again... tha...
Once again, thank you so much from...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you were able to progress 
towards your ideal form is completely 
thanks to the both of your efforts.
On top 
of that ——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The spring winds have not even graced us 
yet… The view you promised me, is that 
still not to come?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Keep looking forward to it for me.
choice_data_list: We'll have to keep honing your skills

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, it seems like you've already got something prepared for me hey.
choice_data_list: From here on, let's hone your runn...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Nice. Surprises like this are always 
welcome.
choice_data_list: That's something to look forward t...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
……You two happen to be quite similar from 
time to time.
Once we returned to the campus ——

To test the results of Stay Gold's 
training, I invited the perfect 
individuals to help us find out.
choice_data_list: I'm putting you against these two

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah…! I see now, so it's these guys.
choice_data_list: Let's show them everything we've w...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hello Stego! Looking forward to our run 
together today.

The two I requested to be Stay Gold's 
running partners are Fuji Kiseki and 
Bubble Gum Fellow.

——Bubble Gum Fellow was the first horse 
girl her age to win the Tenno Sho
(Autumn) 
after it was shortened to 2000 meters.

With this great achievement, she has been 
given a top-class status. Additionally ——

You can say that Fuji Kiseki and
Bubblegum 
Fellow both share similar characteristics 
in their running.

So by extension, Stay Gold's speed also 
matches their characteristics.

Whatever tenacity Stay Gold managed to 
gain through her special training… I 
believe these two are the perfect 
individuals to help her find out…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even so, for the two of you to be here, 
this has become quite the extravagant 
affair.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hearing you say that is a great 
honour to me. Nonetheless, we'd also like 
to reciprocate through our fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's enthusiasm was absolutely 
dazzling. Also ——

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We're curious as to what your "Fast and 
Tenacious Legs" look like.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
…Fuji and myself were both unable to run 
in the Satsuki Sho due to our injuries.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And because of these injuries, we weren't 
able to grasp what the limits of our
speed 
looked like.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to show me up
close. 
If you can compete against our speed, and 
if you could gain something from it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…While our foundations are similar, 
compared to you guys,
how I run is nowhere 
as sophisticated.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So if it's alright with you,
I want you to 
run as you please. In return, I'll be 
taking your running as sustenance for my 
journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
So we're mimicking the Satsuki Sho huh. 
Nice, this'll be interesting ——

Fuji Kiseki and Bubble Gum Fellow
smoothly 
accelerated in the final spurt, meanwhile 
as Stay Gold was hovering in the back ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get going…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ————Haaaaa!!!

Like an vagrant shooting star advancing 
through the sky, Stay Gold burst through 
with all her power saved up for the final 
spurt. Her sharpness,
strength and danger… Unrivalled.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
……Fast and stubborn, I really got to see 
these two qualities hand in hand today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Stego's performance at the Satsuki Sho, 
I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your words. From myself 
also, I'd like to say that you've both 
granted me a great experience.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You'd better stir up a storm in this 
year's Classics! I'll be watching you for 
that!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, please look forward to it. I won't let today's encounter go to waste.

Like this, Stay Gold was able to fully 
absorb their running styles to her
heart's 
content and ——
————That night.

……My heart was still throbbing from the 
adrenaline rush. Feeling the need to calm 
myself down, I wandered outside and ——

She was right there, as if my supposed 
aimless wandering turned out not so 
aimless after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Yo.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The moon looks pretty good today, the sky 
is also quite clear.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…I had a lot of fun today, to think I'd 
even have the chance to race with Fuji
and 
Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…You're right.
I feel like I was only able 
to run with those two because I am on
this 
journey. That's why ——
choice_data_list: I figured it would be a valuable l...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
From now on always, please approach our 
journey in your own way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Because I know, that our journey will be 
far more interesting that way.
choice_data_list: You can leave it to me
You can leave it to me

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, nice. That's reassuring to hear.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me—you're in safe hands.
Leave it to me—you're in good hands.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh～ How thoughtful hey. I'll have one then.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Alright. Should we have ourselves a 
toast?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: For the path that just opened up for us.

…The sound of coffee cans clanking rung 
under the moon.

Indeed, we both couldn't hide our 
expressions to the exhilaration for our 
journey towards the unknown…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …………This is gonna be great.

The unpredictable Satsuki Sho will soon
be 
upon us.
